**Do not file a vulnerability with exploit details in a public issue.** Please use the private reporting channel described in [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md):

https://github.com/promisszn/soroban-amm/security/policy

This template is retained for routing only. Remove secrets, private keys, proof-of-concept payloads, and other sensitive information from any public submission.
